### [`friedman model info`](@id ref-model-info)

Inspect a model handle (.jld2 native, .fmod interim, or model:// session handle): type, versions, dimensions

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|----------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `path` | `String` | yes | — | Path to .jld2/.fmod handle or model:// session handle |

| Option | Short | Type | Default | Choices | Description |
|--------|-------|------|---------|---------|-------------|
| `--output` | `-o` | `String` | `""` | — | Export results to file |
| `--format` | `-f` | `String` | `table` | `table`, `csv`, `json` | table\|csv\|json |

**Output tables:** `model_handle_info` (Handle path, magic, model type, writing and runtime versions, dimensions)

### [`friedman model reproduce`](@id ref-model-reproduce)

Verify a saved handle by re-running its estimator from the recorded seed (reports unverifiable when no seed is recorded)

| Argument | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|----------|------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `path` | `String` | yes | — | Handle path (.jld2, .jls, .fmod, or model:// session handle) |

| Option | Short | Type | Default | Choices | Description |
|--------|-------|------|---------|---------|-------------|
| `--model` | — | `String` | `""` | — | Optional source VARModel handle for two-argument reproduce (e.g. bootstrap ImpulseResponse) |
| `--output` | `-o` | `String` | `""` | — | Export results to file |
| `--format` | `-f` | `String` | `table` | `table`, `csv`, `json` | table\|csv\|json |

**Output tables:** `model_reproduce_summary` (Handle, model type, match verdict, recorded seed, thread counts, note); `model_reproduce_fields` (Per-field re-run comparison (present when the report has field diffs))
